ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms environments, shared cases and the platform-equivalence flag are declared; it does not run on any platform.
offer: Run the same behavioral cases in the required environments and record each result separately. One platform passing does not establish that filesystem or process semantics match another.

minimal.reason: List the environments the cases must run in. One passing platform says nothing about another, so name each OS or runtime.

mid.reason: List the cases shared across those environments. Different cases per platform cannot be compared, so name the common set.

maximal.reason: Set assuming platform equivalence to false. Filesystem and process semantics differ, so record each environment's result separately.
